title: The Dark Culinary Master
text: “Ah, it went by a different name, but yes, there was one. In Dimension Wave, there was an accessory that gave a +3 bonus to Cooking skill, handy for cooking-related quests… though whoever made it, they gave it a terrible name, honestly.”

Itsuki spoke, apparently drawing on some game knowledge, while accepting an apron. I remember it too, indeed. Emerald Online had something similar, indeed. Different name, but it was gear that boosted your cooking success rate, indeed.
“In the world of the future, there are tools like this, you know? So, Itsuki-kun, how about it—want to join in and climb to the top?”

“…I’m glad Naofumi-san and Ren-san aren’t here right now. Not just because Ren-san would go overboard and start firing off Flash Swords, but because I don’t have to witness Naofumi-san’s excited face either.”
Itsuki is saying something rather rude about Father, indeed.
“Father is a man who never forgets the heart of a child, indeed. Above all, he shares that trait with Filolial-sama, who loves a fun atmosphere, indeed.”
“I think the biggest child here is Motoyasu-san, honestly. Anyway, Motoyasu-san’s clearly fired up… no matter what I say, you’re going to force your way in regardless, aren’t you.”
“Naturally, indeed! The Dark Culinary World of Zeltoble? I shall scatter such a thing with ease, indeed! Prepare to witness my cooking, indeed!”
“Motoyasu-sama, has something happened?”
Just then, Yuki-chan came over, indeed.
“Yuki-chan, I’m off to Zeltoble to take part in a cooking duel, indeed!”
“My! Motoyasu-sama is entering a cooking contest, not Naofumi-sama? Yuki would like to come along too.”
“Excellent, indeed! I shall show Yuki-chan my victory, won through my own cooking, indeed!”
“Thank you very much!”
Yuki-chan has given her approval, indeed. This has only fired me up even more!

“The challenger in question has been winning match after match in tournaments held throughout the Dark Culinary World, and has obtained legendary cooking implements as rewards. At this rate, that chef will achieve total domination… we simply cannot allow that to stand, or the Dark Culinary World’s honor will be lost, and that chef will rule over it entirely. Heroes, please—even if victory seems unlikely, would you consider entering?”
“Sigh… well, I suppose there’s no helping it. But—setting Naofumi-san aside—where on earth has Ren-san wandered off to at a time like this…”
“I believe the Spear Hero-sama was said to have an aptitude for fire magic, correct?”
“Yes, Motoyasu-san is skilled with fire magic, but—”
“Then that makes sense. For a chef, an aptitude for fire magic would be quite advantageous.”
At the merchant’s words, Itsuki tilted his head slightly.
“It does seem useful for searing things, I suppose.”
“Indeed. For those aspiring to be chefs, having an aptitude in fire magic or healing magic is preferable… ah, water aptitude works fine too.”
Itsuki has wind and earth, so his aptitudes are a complete miss, indeed.
“I understand the fire magic aptitude part, but… why healing magic?”

“Oh my? The Bow Hero-sama doesn’t know? Healing magic is an attribute that also handles decay, so those with an aptitude for it can unconsciously perform tasks like aging and activating ingredients. In particular, those with pure healing magic aptitude are even more prized than those with fire aptitude.”

Looking at Itsuki’s face, I could tell at a glance what he was thinking. After all, I was thinking the exact same thing, indeed. Father’s specialty magics are healing and support, indeed. Which means Father possesses the innate quality to unconsciously improve ingredients, indeed. No wonder he could cook monster meat—meat that should reek terribly right after the kill—without any stench at all, indeed. Of course, skill-based assistance adds to this as well, indeed. Truly, as expected of Father. This must be one of his secrets, indeed. Here, I raised my hand forcefully, indeed!
“I have an aptitude for fire, so my qualifications are more than sufficient… well then, let us be off at once, indeed!”

And so it was that we ended up entering the Cooking Colosseum as reinforcements for this so-called Dark Culinary World of Zeltoble. As ever, Zeltoble has no shortage of underground colosseums, indeed. We waited in the contestants’ lounge for our call, indeed.
“It really seems we were allowed to enter rather easily.”
“Yeah, Itsuki-kun. Seems like we’re being treated as challengers, joining as one team.”
“I suppose that means we’re just helping out… I left Rishia-san in charge of things while we’re away, but I wonder if she’ll be alright.”
“It’ll be fine, Itsuki-kun. It’s Rishia-chan we’re talking about, right?”
“Well… it’s not like we’ll be away from the village for very long anyway…”
“Spear and Bow Hero-samas, along with your attendants, it’s almost time.”
“Ah, yes.”
“Let us proceed at once, indeed.”

We left the lounge to enter the so-called Cooking Colosseum, indeed. To keep our true identities hidden, each of us wore a mask, indeed. It seemed the colosseum arena was packed with spectators, indeed.
“‘‘‘Oooooooh!!!’’’”
No matter which colosseum you go to, cheers like this always seem to come standard, indeed. Though I do wonder—what on earth are these spectators thinking, coming here in the first place?
“It’s a strange colosseum somehow. There are two competition areas, two kitchens, and a place piled with ingredients… I suppose it’s where each side’s contestants do their cooking, respectively…”
At that moment, a man who appeared to be the emcee descended slowly and theatrically from where the ingredients were placed, microphone in hand, and bellowed out an announcement, indeed.
“Welcome, new challengers of cuisine! Tonight’s challenger is… the Love Hunter, Filolial Mask! And his attendant, New Nambuuuuuuu! And their companions!!”
“Who’s New Nambu?! And more importantly, what is this ring name?!”
“New Nambu, I registered you before you entered, indeed! Be grateful, indeed.”
Itsuki fired his gun straight at me, so I knocked it aside, indeed.
“M-Motoyasu-sama!?”
“HA HA HA! Itsuki’s little pop-gun can’t hit me, indeed.”
“Tch!”
“Itsuki-kun, calm down!”
Now then! Let us behold the face of this so-called tournament wrecker! I thought, just as the opposing contestant made their entrance, indeed.
“Who could possibly defeat him?! Win after win after win! No chef in Zeltoble can stop him anymooore! Beloved by the God of Cuisine! The Cooking Master! Kelsus, and his companions!!”
What appeared there was… someone in a mask who, no matter how you looked at it, could only be Ren, along with Kurotaro wearing bottle-bottom glasses over his mask, and Rafumi, indeed.
“Get ’em, Kelsus!”
“Kelsus! Show us something amazing again today!”
“I can’t wait to see whose food tastes better today!”
Amid the crowd’s clamor, a heavy silence fell between me, Itsuki, Yuki-chan, and Rafuemon on one side, and Ren, Kurotaro, and Rafumi on the other, indeed.
Why on earth is Ren here, indeed? The tournament wrecker is nowhere in sight, indeed? I went over to ask one of the staff, indeed.
“Is that the tournament wrecker, indeed?”
“That’s right. That’s Chef Kelsus and his group, the troublemakers who’ve been running rampant through Zeltoble’s Dark Culinary World lately.”
Hmm… so it seems to be true, indeed.
“…What exactly are you doing, Ren-san?”
Itsuki asked, opening his mouth heavily and directing the question at Ren, indeed.
“I-I have no idea what you mean. Who are you talking about? I’m Kelsus, competing in Zeltoble’s Dark Culinary World tournament. And these two are Kuro and Chocomi.”
“Ren-san, haven’t you already fully awakened into your chuunibyou side? What’s the difference between this ‘Kelsus’ and the Shadow Saint?”

“It’s different! I’ve simply won through cooking duels, nothing more! You seem to be mistaking me for someone else, but this is a place where we compete over whose cooking is superior… a proper, honest contest!”
Ren answered Itsuki’s question with an air of total innocence, feigning ignorance. Talk about digging your own grave with your own words, indeed!
“Honestly… here we are, called in as reinforcements, only to find out the tournament wrecker is you, Ren-san… I’m at a loss for words.”
What a colossal letdown, indeed. If someone like Ren could win match after match, then this Dark Culinary World couldn’t possibly amount to much, indeed.
“I suppose Kurotaro-san must be satisfied too. The Dark Demon Lord Chef, ‘Kelsus,’ was it?”
“I-I’m not Kurotaro, I’m Kuro… and I’m just helping with the dark cuisine…”
Oh, Kurotaro is as painfully awkward as ever, indeed. And yet, he seems to have a faintly pleased look on his face, indeed.
“And… Rafumi-san, what exactly are you doing here too? You came along to keep Ren-san from awakening, and yet you’re participating right alongside him—what is going on?!”
“This is not an awakening. Azott wished it, so support is merely being provided.”
“How is that not awakening… you don’t even get to call Rafuemon-san a wreck anymore. To not even recognize this as an awakening is something else.”
Itsuki let out a deep, heavy sigh, indeed.
“How rude. I demand a retraction.”
“If it bothers you so much, then quit doing it.”
“There’s no obligation to follow that instruction. I’ll answer with these words: say whatever you like.”

“Sigh… so, Ren-san, exactly how did this all come about? Was it something like—your Cooking skill leveled up quite a bit, so you tried entering just to test it out, and then couldn’t back out anymore?”
Judging by Ren’s reaction, that seems to be exactly right, indeed. But Ren, you have made one grave miscalculation, indeed.

“So, um, apparently the prizes at these Dark Culinary World tournaments include things like the Culinary God’s Knife and other legendary cooking implements from that world. The organizers of the Dark Culinary World are in quite a bind—could you return them, perhaps?”

Our weapons’ skill trees are nearly equal in performance, give or take minor differences, indeed. I’ve fully unlocked my cooking-related skills, so our abilities should be equal. Which means, if I, who was already skilled at cooking to begin with, were to face off against Ren, the outcome would be plain as day, indeed. As for how much of a gap that so-called legendary cooking implement might make up—well, considering the base is Ren, it shouldn’t amount to much, indeed.
“Ren, allow yourself to be defeated for the sake of my advancement, indeed.”
“The fact that you can say that with a straight face, given this whole situation, says a lot about you too, honestly… so, what will you do?”

“What are you talking about? That was a legitimate prize I earned through victory. If you want it back, say so after you’ve beaten me. I will never lose. Because I’ve obtained something that—if I may say so myself—is a downright cheat of a knife!”
Ren rejected Itsuki’s proposal outright, indeed. What is this, indeed? Oddly defiant, indeed.
“Sigh… so it’s either the skill or the special effect gained from the Culinary God’s Knife, the tournament prize, that’s got you even more full of yourself.”
“The Culinary God’s Knife? Hmph… don’t you dare lump that mediocre thing together with this knife. The knife I now wield far surpasses the Culinary God’s Knife… a legitimate cheat weapon!”
“A legitimate cheat weapon… that’s a rather contradictory way of putting it, but… what sort of thing could it possibly be?”

Incidentally, all the while we were talking, the emcee behind us kept whipping the crowd into a frenzy at the top of his lungs, indeed. To summarize, tonight’s cooking theme was Western cuisine, indeed. With a sigh, Itsuki looked at the knife—transformed from a sword—that Ren proudly pulled out to show off, indeed. That knife… I feel like I’ve seen it somewhere before, indeed.
“What is it? Some True Chef’s Knife you found somewhere, or an Original Culinary God’s Knife, or maybe a Culinary God’s Knife , or a Culinary God's Knife <Zero Type>?”

“Hmph… listen and be amazed. And once you hear where I obtained it, you’ll understand completely. The place was the village kitchen, where a single blade sat… one that, at a glance, looks like nothing more than an ordinary knife! And yet this knife surpasses even the legendary knives… its name is… Naofumi’s Beloved Knife.”
“Wh—”
Wh… WHAT DID YOU SAY?! Itsuki and I understood exactly what knife Ren was proudly holding aloft, and could do nothing but stand there stunned, indeed.

“Gah… what kind of thing have you gotten your hands on?! This is certainly a unique brand of trouble only Ren-san among the Heroes could cause. Motoyasu-san, do you have any spear that could possibly compete with that?”
“I do not, indeed.”
Gah… I had let my guard down, indeed. There was a terrifyingly formidable enemy here all along, indeed! Even I am not confident I could win, indeed.
“What a preposterous thing to do!”
“Y-yeah, really, Itsuki-kun. Want an apron?”
“I suppose I’ll make use of it… though the odds of it being like pouring water on a burning stone are extremely high, even so…”

I thought I heard a voice from somewhere pointing out the lack of anyone to call out the joke properly, but this was no time for that, indeed. Just when I’d had a winning strategy all worked out, the odds of defeat had suddenly grown thick and heavy right here at the finish line, indeed. This was beyond my grasp, indeed.
“And nooooooow! Let the cooking… BEGIIIIIN!!”
GONG! The deep resounding clang of a great gong echoed through the air.
“Behold and be amazed by my skill! †Instant Mincing†!”

Ren picked up a vegetable resembling an onion, hurled it high into the air with a flourish, then leapt up after it as if in pursuit, unleashing his skill. Countless slashes carved into the onion-like vegetable, and amid a golden radiance, the pieces fell neatly into the bowl held by Kurotaro. Gah… it was just like watching Father’s cooking in action, indeed. Well, no—compared to Father, the base technique seemed a bit more style-over-substance and slightly inefficient, indeed.
